description: Ministry of Defence - Amended Prevention of (Proscription of Extremist Organizations) Regulations No. 2 of 2021, Extra Gazette No. 2223/03
categorisation: This gazette content contains regulations made by the Minister of Defence under the Prevention of Terrorism Act, specifically amending previous regulations by repealing certain items from a schedule. This constitutes legal/regulatory matters involving statutory instruments and modifications to existing legislation, fitting Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes). While it mentions the Minister of Defence by name, it does not contain detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes that would qualify it for Types 1-3.
